title: Asia-Pacific Enforcement Actions — MAS, ASIC, HKMA, FSA, SEBI

cases.summary: MAS revoked the Major Payment Institution licence of Sir Money Changer for persistent AML/CFT failures: failed to perform CDD for cash transactions above S$5,000 for three consecutive years, did not retain transaction records as required, and failed to file suspicious transaction reports for high-risk customers.

ASIC issued A$4.356 million in infringement notices against 22 companies for AFSL and ACL breaches. Five are fintech operators offering embedded lending products. Highest single notice: A$395,000 against a BNPL provider for failure to assess suitability. Notices issued under ASIC's expanded infringement notice powers.

cases.firm: Prudential Life Insurance Company of Japan
cases.summary: Japan FSA imposed a partial business suspension order against Prudential Life Insurance for systematic mis-selling of variable life insurance to elderly customers. 847 cases found where products were sold to customers with inappropriate risk profiles. Suspension covers new policy sales through tied agents for three months.

ASIC commenced Federal Court proceedings against ANZ for allegedly misleading retail clients about protections afforded to their money held in investment accounts. ASIC alleges failures under Part 7.8 of the Corporations Act 2001 related to client money disclosures. Proceedings ongoing.
